articles.facts: DEFAULT needs no capability bit; ONE and IMMEDIATE are accepted when advertised. TWO/THREE/FOUR require caps and are unavailable windowed.
A D3D8 windowed chain uses the DEFAULT presentation-interval field; explicit intervals belong to fullscreen chains.

scope: Presentation-interval field validation before allocation, window mutation or Reset state changes in D3D8/9 CreateDevice, Reset and CreateAdditionalSwapChain. Accepted windowed parameters execute the complete guest call path; valid fullscreen intervals are covered by 4H6e1. Other presentation fields, complete Reset semantics, additional-chain rendering/pacing and native Microsoft HAL behavior remain outside this step.
